title: Cohen-Macaulay approximations over generically Gorenstein rings
summary: Let $(R,\mathfrak{m})$ be a Cohen-Macaulay local ring with canonical module that is generically Gorenstein. In this paper, I prove isomorphisms relating the minimal MCM approximations and minimal FID hulls of modules constructed from a canonical ideal $\,ω\subset R$, including $\,ω/xR$, with $\,x \in ω\,$ a nonzerodivisor, $\,(ω/xR)^{\vee}:=\text{Ext}^1_R(ω/xR,ω)$, $\,R/ω^2$, and $\,ω/ω^2$.
